title: A single concept gives one new term a clear meaning before learners need to use it.
summary: The frame keeps the term, plain-language meaning, and a few useful cues visible at the same time so the explanation does not become a wall of notes.
footer: Use this when one concept needs a calm first introduction.

callout.label: Teaching move
callout.value: Name the idea before asking learners to apply it.

definition.meaning: A small, concrete example that gives a new idea somewhere stable to land before the learner has to generalize it.

keyPoints.label: Notice
keyPoints.detail: Start with one detail the learner can already see or hear.

keyPoints.label: Name
keyPoints.detail: Attach the new term after the shared detail is visible.

keyPoints.label: Use
keyPoints.detail: Ask for one short application while the example remains on screen.
